title: [E-Documents] Add support for credit memos, recognised from the PDF and applied to the original invoice
summary: E-Documents now recognize vendor credit notes in PDFs and create purchase credit memos instead of invoices. A credit memo is applied to the invoice printed on the document only when exactly one open posted invoice of the pay-to vendor matches in an applicable currency; otherwise it stays unapplied with a warning.
key_points: Extraction returns the EN 16931 document type code and billing reference; code maps 381 to a credit memo and anything else to an invoice
Credit memos are applied only to the stated invoice when exactly one open posted invoice of the pay-to vendor matches in an applicable currency
Otherwise the credit memo is left unapplied with a warning, and finalizing re-checks the match
Draft gets an editable Applies-to Vendor Inv. No. field and a read-only outcome field
Amount signs are normalized from the lines first, then the header totals
